intro: Hebrews was written to Jewish Christians tempted to give up, and go back. Its message: Jesus is greater than everything that came before.
Chapters one to ten show Jesus as greater than the angels, greater than Moses, and the perfect high priest and sacrifice.
Chapters eleven to thirteen call for faith and endurance, with a great list of heroes of faith.
Listen for chapter eleven, and its opening line: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for.
